description: The same action has three names, and the adjacent button is a near miss.
expected: One label, and the toolbar button next to 'Traces' clearly the setup action.
actual: Toolbar 'Capture...', drive menu 'Capture traces...', dialog title 'Capture traces'; 'Traces' (next to it) opens the folder instead. On a 390px screen the toolbar buttons are hidden and Capture traces... exists only inside the drive-name dropdown.
suggested_fix: Use one label (for example 'Capture traces') in the toolbar and menu, and surface it on mobile.

description: The one-time token block is below Local agents and the Active/Replace/Revoke row, and the dialog is taller than an 800px window.
expected: Token and copy buttons visible without scrolling; Replace not prominent while the one-time secret is on screen.
actual: Dialog scrollHeight 807 vs 750 visible; header scrolls away; the large Replace button sits directly above the unsaved token.
suggested_fix: Put the new token block at the top of the webhook section, collapse Local agents once a token is shown, make the header sticky.

description: Setup silently creates an agent named openrouter. The Agents tab shows it with 'NO API KEYS' and a '0' avatar, with no explanation.
expected: The dialog (or Agents row) says the agent identity is for webhook traces and needs no key.
actual: Nothing in the dialog mentions it; Agents row looks unfinished.
suggested_fix: Add one sentence to the token view and a hint on the Agents row; use the first letter as avatar.

description: 'Copied' is wider than 'Copy', so the code boxes re-wrap after a copy; four buttons all read just 'Copy'.
expected: Fixed-width button so the code box does not shift; visible label saying what is copied.
actual: Webhook URL breaks at a different character after copy; Headers box also shifts.
suggested_fix: Give the copy button a fixed min-width; label them 'Copy URL' and 'Copy headers'.

description: The drive-name switcher truncates 'priya-agents' to 'priya-agent...' at 1280px although there is free space beside it.

Privacy Mode warning is shown only after the token is created, at the bottom of a long dialog; the Local agents text says only 'Check terminal output: capture may be disabled...' without naming the messages.
expected: Warning shown before the user goes to OpenRouter; message names given or linked.
actual: Only after token creation; docs hold the message list.
suggested_fix: Show the Privacy Mode note next to the Add webhook button; link the docs page for capture messages.
